headline: Buy Seagate for the year: BofA and Morgan Stanley both see $1,200, ~79% above the premarket price, as Nasdaq futures slide 1.8%; Lockheed beats and raises, Block gets a BMO upgrade, and the Clippers, Packers, Kings, Grizzlies and Jazz trade under the sportsbook lines
top_call: BofA and Morgan Stanley both see Seagate at $1,200, about 79% above today's dip on hard-drive demand. Buy it for the year.
backdrop: Nasdaq 100 futures -1.8% and S&P 500 futures -1.0% early Thursday as Tesla (-3.5% premarket) and AI chip names slide and Brent tops $111 on Mideast tensions; Meta's beat did little to calm AI-spending worries. P&G, Lockheed and Honeywell report this morning.

finance.label: LMT
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Thu Oct 22 7:10 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Q3 EPS of $7.97 beat by 45 cents, sales rose 11%, backlog hit a record $292B and 2026 guidance went up again.
finance.risk: Shares are already up ~3% premarket, and F-35 Lot 20 costs are running past current government funding.

finance.label: TSLA
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Thu Oct 22 7:11 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Our read: Tesla cut its sales goal to 5M cars by 2030 (from 20M) and Musk tempered Optimus hopes; fade it in a risk-off tape.
finance.risk: It beat on EPS ($0.48 vs $0.45), margins improved and SpaceX merger headlines can squeeze shorts at any moment.

finance.label: META
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Thu Oct 22 7:11 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Barclays lifts its Meta PT to $880 (Overweight): core ads grew 26% ex-FX vs 24% expected and Muse passed 10M sign-ups.
finance.risk: Capex runs $135-145B this year with no 2027 number yet, and legal costs ($9.9B charge) keep hitting headlines.

finance.label: IBM
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Thu Oct 22 7:10 AM ET premarket
finance.why: JPMorgan lifts IBM's PT to $269 after a beat ($2.95 EPS) and a raised software outlook; we buy the ~5% premarket dip.
finance.risk: Investors fear the software rebound was delayed deals closing, and 2027 growth may not hold near double digits.

finance.label: XYZ
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Thu Oct 22 7:02 AM ET premarket
finance.why: BMO upgrades Block to Outperform, PT $101 from $85, on accelerating Square payment volume heading into 2027.
finance.risk: Fintech multiples are volatile in a risk-off market, and Cash App growth still has to keep pace with Square.

finance.label: STX
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Thu Oct 22 7:11 AM ET premarket
finance.why: BofA lifts its Seagate PT to $1,200 (Buy) on hard-drive demand and pricing; Morgan Stanley also sits at $1,200.
finance.risk: Fiscal Q1 results land Oct 27, and the stock is down ~4% premarket with AI hardware names selling off.

ai.headline: AI helped find two critical PHP flaws that let attackers run code on web servers without logging in
ai.why: Wiz says 'PHP2Shell' touches ~70% of the web; Finland briefly shut government sites. AI is now speeding up both bug hunting and exploits.

ai.headline: Meta narrows 2026 capex to $135-145B as Q3 revenue hits $64.6B and Muse tops 10 million accounts
ai.why: The biggest AI spender says ads are paying for it (core ads +26%), but gave no 2027 number, and Nasdaq futures still fell 1.8%.

ai.headline: OpenAI's frontier models and Codex are coming to Google Cloud, sold through its Marketplace
ai.why: Google Cloud customers can spend existing commitments on a rival's models; OpenAI widens its reach beyond Microsoft Azure.

ai.headline: Anthropic opens a waitlist for Claude Duet, a proactive agent that works in the background and asks before acting
ai.why: It's Anthropic's answer to Meta's Muse: personal agents that watch your apps and finish tasks are the next consumer AI battleground.

ai.headline: DHS orders federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and anything built on them
ai.why: A formal FASCSA order turns China AI worries into a procurement ban; vendors using DeepSeek models in their products are covered too.
